verdict.rationale: Semgrep's documented automation is event-triggered: CI jobs on push and pull-request events, pre-commit hooks, and Managed Scans for bulk onboarding. Nothing in the evidence documents a product-native recurring schedule (cron-style or time-based) for scans or workflows. Event triggers and any scheduling done by the host CI provider are adjacent or host-platform capabilities, not this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
